blocks.html:
This method manages the prices of a price list to create, update, or delete them.
It sends a request to the [Manage Prices](https://docs.medusajs.com/v2/api/admin#price-lists\_postpricelistsidpricesbatch)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The prices to create, update, or delete.

children.name: create
children.description: The prices to create and add to the price list.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The price's currency code.

children.name: amount
children.description: The price's amount.

children.name: variant_id
children.description: The ID of the variant this price applies to.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity that must be available in the cart for the price to be applied.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity allowed to be available in the cart for the price to be applied.

children.description: The price's rules.
